suites.title: SQLite speedtest1
blockers: Migrate existing speedtest1 builds to the shared application runner; preserve its SQL oracle.
Build matching CheriBSD engine, allocator configuration and dataset.

suites.title: Python pyperformance
blockers: Run upstream workload bodies with a fixed work count; the pyperf subprocess controller cannot run inside the current domain.
Qualify dependencies and output oracles; label a host-driven subset explicitly.
Build matching CheriBSD CPython and account separately for pymalloc arenas and object slots.

suites.title: mruby upstream benchmark directory
blockers: Measure the nested GC boundary for lists and Mandelbrot, plus more AO work sizes.
Account for node, shadow and revocation storage before a total-memory ranking.

suites.title: Perl core performance workloads
blockers: Porting/bench.pl drives Cachegrind; extract pinned workload definitions with a reviewed fixed-iteration adapter.
Expand regex-family into explicit upstream case IDs before qualification.
Qualify CheriBSD Perl; a whole-interpreter Sublet integration is not yet available.

suites.title: SPEC CPU2017 perlbench
blockers: Needs a locally supplied licensed source package and content hashes.
Uses its own modified interpreter; this is a separate port, not a benchmark of the existing Perl 5.36.3 binary.
Modified memory runs are not official SPEC scores.

suites.title: PostgreSQL pgbench
blockers: Current Capstone application is a single-user backend; full pgbench needs client/server, IPC, process and filesystem support.
A single-user execution of the SQL bodies must be a separately named derived workload.
Integrate memory-context Sublet support into the application, beyond allocator replay.

suites.title: FFmpeg FATE decode corpus
blockers: Select explicit supported FATE cases and hash each sample and reference output; FATE is not a performance suite.
Label fixed-work memory measurements over FATE samples as an adaptation.
Bridge AVBufferPool/AVRefStructPool Sublet integration into the application runner.

suites.title: Phoronix FFmpeg profile
blockers: Pin the profile source, inputs and commands before qualification.
The configured MPEG-4 decoder does not provide the full ffmpeg CLI and required encoding libraries.

deferred.tshark: Application dependency build incomplete; later use pinned upstream captures and offline dissection workloads.
deferred.nginx, APR/httpd, memcached, Whisper: Allocator components exist; they are not qualified application ports in this study.
deferred.MicroPython: Excluded from this study per the requested CPython focus.
